import json,urllib.request,urllib.parse,re,sys,importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("m","/root/direct-sync/maersk_track_sync.py")

    ev2,note2=(m.maersk_events(env,tok,c,"equipmentReference") if c else (None,"немає контейнера"))
